_comment: Character file settings (tools/sprite_codegen.py). colours: firmware colours of personal pens 6-9, first one also the health bar; alt_colours: the same for the second fighter in a mirror match; merge: art pen -> art pen, for art colours that are neither shared nor personal; special: the special move's kind (strike, projectile: file, speed in bytes per picture, damage, hitstun; throw); stage: the home stage (art/stages), where fighter B's character fights; taunt: the victory line under "NAME WINS!" (24 characters at most: A-Z, 0-9, space and !?.,'-:).
